Hi Jeremy / Linda —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Per our conversation, I've pulled together a compact mutual action plan (attached) and proposed executive briefing (EB) timeslots so we can lock the close timeline before procurement starts their redlines. High level: we want to (a) align exec sponsors, (b) finalize the evaluation plan for the clinical pilot, and (c) lock two EB windows for your leadership and our execs.

Quick ask: please confirm which of the two EB windows works for Pinnacle leadership (we can be flexible on the shorter option if that helps):
- Option A: Tue Dec 1, 09:00–10:00 PT (preferred)
- Option B: Thu Dec 3, 15:00–16:00 PT

Proposed sponsor mapping (draft) — please flag changes:
- Executive Sponsor (business): Jeremy Cole (Pinnacle) -> Marissa Cole (Redwood, SVP Customer Success)
- Executive Sponsor (technical/clinical): Linda Park (Pinnacle) -> Karthik Iyer (Redwood, Head of Solutions)
- Contract/Commercial owner: Procurement (Pinnacle) -> Ben Carter (Redwood, Enterprise Sales)

Key MAP milestones and target dates (draft):
- Evaluation plan signoff (requirements + pilot scope) — Nov 24
- Technical due diligence & architecture workshop — Nov 27
- EB (exec briefing) — one of the slots above (target to finalize before Nov 26)
- Final SOW/contract routing — Dec 4–8

Attachments: Pinnacle_MAP_v2.xlsx, EB_invite_draft.ics (invite template).

If you can confirm sponsor names and preferred EB slot by EOD Thursday (Nov 19), Ben and I will finalize invites and push the DocuSign flow.

Thanks —
Chloe Martin
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
